summary: Comprehensive testing of SFX, Music Volume, Captions, and Slide Title features. Backend: 6/6 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working correctly - SFX Use/Active toggle, BGM volume slider with 40% display, Caption style presets (6 styles), Display Mode toggle, Position selector, Font dropdown, Font Size slider, Custom Colors with Reset buttons, Preview box, Slide Title controls with 4 position options and Visible/Hidden toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: Music tab: BGM volume slider uses controlled 'value' prop correctly (fixed from defaultValue). Volume changes update bgmVolume in project store via setBgmVolume()

SFX Use button: Clicking assigns sfxUrl and sfxName to selected slide. Shows 'Active' state when SFX is assigned. Clicking Active SFX removes it (toggle behavior). 'Slide SFX: {name}' indicator shows at top of SFX section

Caption controls: All 6 style presets work (Bold Pop, Minimal, TikTok, Neon, Netflix, Glass). Display Mode (Sentence/Lines/Words), Position (Top/Center/Bottom), Font dropdown, Font Size slider (24-72px), Custom Colors with Reset buttons all functional
Caption Preview: Shows 'Sample caption text' at bottom of Captions tab with current styling applied
Slide Title controls: Title Text input editable, Title Position buttons (Top L, Top C, Bot L, Bot C) work, Visible/Hidden toggle works. Canvas preview shows title overlay at selected position
Backend /api/render: Accepts new caption params (captionFont, captionColor, captionBgColor, captionPosition, captionSize) - all tested and working
seed_data_creation: None - used existing project 'AI Quick Test: Understanding the Basics'
